nodes.label: AI-Suplex 777
nodes.desc: The free, open-source foundation — portable workspaces, tasklists, sessions and the 3-layer memory stack. Give your AI agents a memory that survives the chat.

nodes.label: AI-Suplex Ultra
nodes.desc: The intelligence layer on top of 777 — reads the work you already captured and surfaces the opportunities, risks and priorities that matter most. The MVP carries six surfaces: Opportunity Mapper, Knowledge Graph and Deep Ultra Mode ship today; Skills Evolution, Insight Resonance and AS Mission Control complete the set.

nodes.label: WQR — WhatsApp Quick Responder
nodes.desc: A production WhatsApp AI commerce agent for African SMEs — 7-intent classifier, live inventory pricing, and EcoCash and Paynow payment integration.

nodes.label: Workflow Console
nodes.desc: A local-first app that operates the vault — create workspaces from a form, see Today's pipeline, and compose the 23 AI-Suplex commands. The console composes and validates; the vault writes. Ships as a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux: download, run, no Node install.

nodes.label: Agents Terminal V3
nodes.desc: A multi-agent orchestration platform — runs specialised sub-agents as Docker services, with an orchestrator that reviews every interaction and proposes weekly upgrades, human in the loop.

nodes.label: Graph RAG
nodes.desc: Structured retrieval over the knowledge graph — the Knowledge Graph surface of the Ultra MVP, shipped. One question answered twice: keyword retrieval scores A, graph retrieval follows the edges for B — the gap is the product.

nodes.label: Deep Ultra Mode
nodes.desc: The boss-rush execution mode — one mechanic, three voices (arcade, operative, pro), the FINAL BOSS constant. Turns a tasklist into a mission; a shipped Ultra MVP surface.

nodes.label: Living Wiki
nodes.desc: Auto-structures captured work into a browsable knowledge base — memory made usable, not another graph database.

nodes.label: Opportunity Mapper
nodes.desc: Reads the outreach, completed work and follow-ups already in your vault and surfaces the up-sells, cross-sells and overlooked opportunities sitting there — never inventing revenue or prices. A shipped Ultra MVP surface.

nodes.label: Skills Evolution
nodes.desc: The skill layer that compounds — what worked, what faded, and what gets promoted next, gated by human approval.

nodes.label: Insight Resonance
nodes.desc: Resonance scoring across your captured insights — a deterministic floor first, optional AI enrichment clearly separated.

nodes.label: AS Mission Control
nodes.desc: The system that keeps the loop running — schedules, rituals and the operating rhythm that makes the work compound.

nodes.label: 3lm Memory
nodes.desc: The 3-layer memory stack — episodic, semantic, procedural — and the compound loop (end → learn → promote → index). Every new session starts smarter than the last.

nodes.label: Outreach Entity
nodes.desc: The external loop — tracks sends, follows up, gates replies.

nodes.label: File Modality Bridge
nodes.desc: convert.js — turns non-markdown files into markdown for ingestion.

nodes.label: knowledge-graph.js
nodes.desc: SQLite graph CLI — query, hubs, path tracing. 1,642 entities and 4,865 edges on the build vault.

nodes.label: vault-index.js
nodes.desc: Builds the entity index the graph ingests.

nodes.label: bbomb_hunter.py
nodes.desc: Ranks B-Bomb candidates for promotion.
